text: Zither HarpHello everyoneTogether with us we have Lucas and JoyceNice to see you againIn today's lesson we are going to talk about how to do picture writingYou learned how to write on pictures in Unit 5 of Book 8AIt was based on three charactersA little dinosaur, Diogenes and Walt DisneyBut today we are going to learn to write about treesBefore you start writing, please look at these two comic stripsWhat does the first group of pictures show us, Joyce?It shows how trees clean the airThat's itWhat about the next comic strip, Lucas?It is about how trees protect themselvesYes, pictures are used to give some details of a story or a procedureFrom the information we get from the pictures, we know about the topic图片中所反映的信息可以帮助我们确定写画的内容Now, let's take the second comic strip as an exampleTo begin with a story, we need to think about four elementsFor short, we call them four WThey are who, where, when and whatPlease look at the pictures carefully and figure out the four elements of this story图片中所反映的信息可以帮助我们确定写画的内容Please look at the picture carefully and figure out the four elements of this story图片中所反映的信息可以帮助我们确定写画的内容Please look at the picture carefully and figure out the four elements of this story图片中所反映的信息可以帮助我们确定写画的内容中文字幕不足Good.We call them characters in the story.故事中的主人公Then, where does the story happen, Lucas?I think it's in the forest.When does it happen, Lucas?I'm not sure.Should I use one day to start the story?Of course.From the picture, we really don't know what the time is.But to write a story, we can make up a time.We can use one day, one morning, on a sunny morning and so on.Then, what happens?The insect gets into the forest.From the first picture, I can see it is hungry and it wants to eat the leaves of the trees.We don't need to write about all the trees.We can choose one tree to be the leader.Maybe all the other trees listen to the leader.To make the story interesting, we can also give the characters names.Shall we call the insect, Insect Gawk, and the leader of the trees, Captain Tree?After we know the scene, the pictures reflect, and the four elements of the story, what should we do?We should understand what each picture tells about.Now, please look at the pictures again and answer my question.Look at picture one.What is Insect Gawk doing in this picture?Lucas, please.It is walking towards the trees in the forest.Since we gave the insect a name, we can use he or she here.He has arrived in the forest and is approaching the trees.How does he feel?He is hungry.What about the trees, Joyce?They see the insect and they are frightened.But do they need to be afraid?No, they don't.Why not?Because they can produce a chemical to make their leaves taste nasty.Good.Let's talk about picture two then.What do these wavy lines mean, Lucas?The nasty smell of the leaves?The information they are passing to each other.Yes, they mean the trees are communicating with each other.I agree with you.But at this moment, why are they communicating with each other?Maybe Captain Tree is warning the other trees.How do they do that?They join their roots in the forest.They join their roots together.But we don't know how, right?Now, the last picture.Look at insect Gawk.What happens to him, Joyce?He is leaving the forest sadly.Because he cannot taste a single delicious leaf.Poor Gawk.How do the trees feel now?They are happy, excited.Very good.The pictures are not very difficult for us to understand.But I still think there is something missing between the pictures.Let's look at picture two.How can the trees spread the warning?Maybe insect Gawk climbs up Captain Tree and started to eat leaves.Captain Tree passes the information to the trees around him.And then the information is spread.Very good guessing.So between the first two pictures, we should have the detail of starting to pass information to others.What about the second and the third pictures?The trees start to produce the chemical.The nasty leaves keep insect Gawk away.This leads to the ending of the story.That is, insect Gawk leaves sadly.So when we write about pictures, don't describe the pictures only.We should also find the gap between the pictures.We need to write about the missing information too.Now we need to think about what tense we can use to write the story.When we write a story, we can use either the simple present tense or the simple past tense.当我们在写一个故事的时候,通常可以用一般现在时或一般过去时。Today we choose the simple present tense to write the story.今天我们要选用一般现在时来完成这个故事的写作。To make your story lively, you need to add some dialogues.Sometimes, the characters speak to each other.Sometimes, they say to themselves.Now, please take out your worksheet.Try to complete the speech bubbles and the thought bubbles with what they say and think.You will have two minutes to complete the task.Now, please take out your worksheet and complete the task one.Let's look at Joyce's work.Joyce really did the job.In Picture 1, we found a very specific way to build this story.We don't have the straight line, so we don't need to use the straight lines,We only use the dialogue lines to highlight the wrong parts.It's like we are writing a story.現在,在一張圖片中,你的說話顯示,動物神很高興,但是,在三張圖片中,你的說話顯示,祂感到非常失望。在二張圖片中,你加了一段和其他樹木之間的對話。樹木已經接受了樹木神的指令,並且準備好了。所以,當你寫一篇故事時,不要經常描述在你的說話中的行動,加上一些對話,並且嘗試令你的寫作生生盛盛。讓我們來總結一下我們要做的事情,當我們寫圖片時。首先,要交代清楚故事的主人公,故事發生的時間、地點,以及事件的起因。其次,要仔細觀察圖片中的細節,理解每幅圖片的含義。然後,還要能夠發現圖片之間的關聯,彌補圖片當中缺失的信息。接著,你要確定自己寫作的主要時態。最後,為了讓寫作的內容更為生動,你還要適時的加入一些內心獨白,或者是對話。當然,寫作過程當中,也要注意拼寫和語法的正確。現在,是時候讓你寫自己的故事。請在工作圖片中完成Task
